targets.text: The Jetson AGX Orin serves the mesh's decision models — Cloudflare Clef 27B (schema-scored decisions, Ampere-fit 4-bit) and, later, a fine-tuned Strands Decider 2B — through lobes, addressable from every mesh member

Clef answers model=decider on the Orin through the gateway with orin-embed's three lanes still serving, and a 2B decider answers from at least one other box — both shown in an acceptance transcript under docs/evidence/ (#108), not declared.

Clef is served through a decision endpoint (the card's documented route is SGLang exposing a Jev/SystemOne-compatible POST /v1/systemone with state + questions), not the OpenAI chat surface; a plain 'vllm serve' never runs the joint head, so lobes needs a new non-chat lane type the gateway can route — nothing under lobes/ or docs/ mentions systemone today.
The gateway proxies POST /v1/systemone to the decider lane byte-for-byte (no reshaping) and 404s role_infeasible when no decider is hosted or reachable.

Clef's 4-bit checkpoint on the Orin (Ampere sm_87) must be WEIGHT-ONLY W4A16 through Marlin: W4A4 NVFP4 needs Blackwell FP4 tensor cores and is ruled out (lobes/machines/orin.py:10-30) and FP8 W8A8 is unsupported on Ampere. Lead candidate JRamirez-UAB/clef-GPTQ-W4A16-g64-embed-int8 (compressed-tensors, ~18 GB, head/ViT/lm_head bf16, vLLM 0.31.0 + a 4-line qwen3_5 embed-quant patch + clef_vllm.py pooling wrapper, 65/68 match vs bf16); second AutomatosX/AX-Clef-27B-CUDA-AXQ-NVFP4-W4A16; avoid kurcontko/simonlehmann clef-NVFP4 (W4A4) and prithivMLmods/clef-FP8.
The served Clef build's config.json quant_method is weight-only (W4A16/WNA16 or NF4) and vLLM/transformers logs show a Marlin/weight-only kernel, never an FP4-activation path, on sm_87.

Neither model is the 'hand' role: hand forbids final_decision (lobes/roles.py ROLE_FORBIDDEN, hand ~:537; docs/colleague-stack.md:58 'never decides') and its LoRA serving is vLLM --enable-lora on a generate lane (lobes/templates/fleet/docker-compose.yml:790-880) — a pointer/schema head is not a generate adapter.
decider's ROLE_FORBIDDEN and hand's stay distinct; no decider checkpoint is routed through vllm-hand's --enable-lora lane.

Clef takes the Orin's single heavy-lobe slot: orin.toml [[exclusive_roles]] (~:117-119) allows one of cortex/senses/associate (orin-cortex/orin-lobe/orin-associate) on 61.3 GiB unified with zero swap, so a Clef-hosting shape joins that exclusive group (and tests/test_init_coresidency.py) and cannot co-reside with the GGUF cortex (~33 GiB) or associate (util 0.70).
orin.toml exclusive_roles and tests/test_init_coresidency.py are updated so a Clef-hosting shape is refused alongside cortex/senses/associate.

Adding the 'decider' role touches every per-role surface: ROLES + ROLE_BACKEND/ROLE_ROLE_HINT/ROLE_PATH/ROLE_RESPONSIBILITIES/ROLE_FORBIDDEN/ROLE_MAX_MODEL_LEN_ENV (lobes/roles.py:113-559), COLLEAGUE_ROLES/OPT_IN_CORE_ROLES (lobes/profiles/shapes.py:92,114), schema.py role scope, render.py ROLE_ENV_PREFIX, shape_render.py + cli/_commands/up.py ROLE_SERVICE, gateway/_config.py OPT_IN_BACKENDS/FEASIBLE_ENV/*_BASE_URL, the fleet compose template, every builtin profile + shape TOML, and the ~28-40 golden .env files (tests/goldens/regen.py) — plus a /v1/systemone route the gateway proxies and mesh-forwards (no 'decider' name collides today; only a comment at lobes/roles.py:474 uses the word).
tests/goldens/regen.py regenerates every golden with a decider line and the full suite passes; docs/colleague-stack.md records the decider role's justification for the irreversible add.
The jev-factory work (producing decider training data / retraining) runs in a separate session and is not part of this frame; this frame consumes its output only.
No jev-factory/training code lands in this repo's PRs for this frame.

Mesh agents and harnesses (culture agents, Qwen Code, reachy-mini-cli, lobes route) that need a fast, calibrated multiple-choice decision — routing, tool selection, triage, guardrails — instead of parsing a chat model's prose; and the operator deploying it.
At least one named consumer (lobes route or a culture agent) has a concrete decision it would send to /v1/systemone instead of a chat completion.

Today the fleet has no decision model: every typed decision is a chat completion whose answer must be parsed out of prose (lobes route asks the hand model for JSON, lobes/cli/_commands/route.py), with no per-option probabilities, and no lobes surface knows /v1/systemone.
grep finds no systemone/decider surface in lobes/ on main at the time of writing (verified 2026-10-14 in the scope pass).

A schema-scored decision returns calibrated probabilities over a closed option set in one forward pass — no generation, no output parsing, no hallucinated option — so callers can threshold on confidence and escalate to cortex only when the decider is unsure.
The per-option probabilities the decider returns are usable for thresholding — the strands/clef cards' calibration claims hold on our own probe set, or the caveat is recorded.

Any mesh member answers model=decider on POST /v1/systemone: the Orin serves Clef 27B (4-bit, co-resident with orin-embed) and any box may host a Strands Decider 2B; GET /capabilities advertises the decider role with its checkpoint, quant and feasibility, and a box that hosts none forwards to a verified member.
Every surface named (model=decider, /v1/systemone, /capabilities advert, mesh forwarding) exists and is exercised by a test or an evidence transcript.

On the Orin, with orin-embed still serving: Clef (4-bit) answers a /v1/systemone choice question through the gateway with probabilities summing to 1 (±0.01) per question, top-1 accuracy on a fixed LABELED probe set (ground-truth answers, no bf16 reference run) is recorded beside the quant card's published bf16 agreement (65/68), and the minimum available host memory stays >= 2 GiB (orin-embed decision c25 floor); median decision latency for a <= 4096-token state is recorded (sidecar baseline, then the faster path).
The labeled probe set, its ground-truth answers, the measured top-1 accuracy and the latency numbers are filed in a docs/evidence/ transcript; no bf16 Clef is booted anywhere for this measurement.
A Strands Decider 2B served bf16 on a second box (e.g. spark2) answers model=decider:<domain> from every other mesh member, with X-Lobes-Mesh-Member on the reply.
The 2B is booted on a box other than the Orin and reached cross-box via the mesh, transcripted.

decider role contract: responsibilities typed_decision, classification, routing_choice, triage, guardrail_check, final_decision; forbidden repo_action, security_decision — it decides over a closed option set and returns the best answer + all probabilities, but never acts on the repo or rules on security.
lobes/roles.py ROLE_RESPONSIBILITIES/ROLE_FORBIDDEN for decider match this text and tests/test_colleague_contract.py pins it.

Domain routing: each decider:<domain> is advertised in GET /capabilities with its checkpoint and quant and mesh-forwarded by name (like a specialist lane, docs/colleague-stack.md#specialist-lanes-not-roles); a domain name must be mesh-unique — two members announcing the same domain with different fingerprints is a refused conflict, never a silent pick; an unknown domain 404s model_not_found (mirrors hand:<domain>).
A test registers two members announcing the same domain with different fingerprints and asserts the conflict is refused; a cross-box decider:<domain> forward is shown in an evidence transcript.

The decider lane's readiness probe uses a per-lane health path: strands-decider documents only POST /v1/systemone (no /health, no /v1/models), and lobes/gateway/_readiness.py probes /health then /v1/models — so a decider lane needs the probe_backend_ready health_path override the innereye lane already uses (_readiness.py:153-158), or it is advertised ready:false forever.
A gateway test wires a decider backend that 404s /health and /v1/models but answers its configured health path, and asserts /capabilities reports it ready:true.

Decider containers publish NO host port and listen only on the compose network: the strands-decider server documents no auth, while the gateway's bearer gate covers every /v1/* path (lobes/gateway/server.py:5199) — the gateway is the only way in.
The rendered compose for every decider service has no 'ports:' mapping (golden-checked), and an evidence transcript shows the decider port refused from another host while the gateway route answers.

Moving the Orin from orin-embed to a Clef-hosting shape keeps orin-embed as the rollback: back up ~/.lobes before the render and restore the backup to roll back — a re-render alone is NOT a rollback (docs/orin-embed-deployment.md:136-147, ...-rollback-orin-embed-to-orin-associate.txt).
The Orin acceptance transcript records the ~/.lobes backup path taken before the render, and the rollback procedure is written in the deployment doc.

The mesh roster carries decider DOMAINS as a new announced dimension: today a role pools members by fingerprint and exposes a disagreeing member as {role}-{machine} (lobes/gateway/_mesh_routing.py:631-668, member_lanes :932), which cannot express c34's flat decider:<domain> namespace or its refuse-on-conflict rule — the announce/verify/route path needs a per-domain key.

A unit test announces decider:general from the Orin and a 2B domain from spark2 and asserts a third member routes each by domain, and that two members announcing one domain with different fingerprints are refused.

tasks.summary: Spike: load a 4-bit Clef + its joint schema head under transformers on the Orin, beside the live orin-embed shape
acceptance_criteria: docs/evidence/<date>-spike-clef-sidecar-orin.txt records: the exact checkpoint id + HF revision, its config.json quant_method (weight-only: W4A16/WNA16 or NF4 — never an FP4-activation path), the transformers/torch versions, resident memory, and min available host memory (>= 2 GiB) while orin-embed's three lanes keep answering

the transcript shows one /v1/systemone-shaped choice decision answered with per-option probabilities summing to 1 (±0.01) and its latency for a <= 4096-token state — or a NO-GO with the failing step and error text
tasks.instruction: Live-box task, not a coding task. Run in a scratch container on the Orin with a hard --memory cap and HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET=1 (zero-swap board; an uncapped download OOM-killed a lane before). Evict page cache before load (posix_fadvise DONTNEED). Try in order: JRamirez-UAB/clef-GPTQ-W4A16-g64-embed-int8 via transformers compressed-tensors, then a bitsandbytes NF4 build (Aikimi/clef-nf4 or jlancaster/clef-27b-nf4) — read each card first and verify the joint head files (joint_head.safetensors, joint_schema_model.py) load over the quantized backbone. Do NOT touch ~/.lobes or the live compose project. Never name non-fleet containers seen on any box in the transcript.

tasks.summary: Add the decider role to lobes/roles.py: ROLES and every per-role table
acceptance_criteria: lobes/roles.py ROLES contains 'decider'; ROLE_RESPONSIBILITIES['decider'] == (typed_decision, classification, routing_choice, triage, guardrail_check, final_decision) and ROLE_FORBIDDEN['decider'] == (repo_action, security_decision), pinned by a test in tests/test_colleague_contract.py
ROLE_FORBIDDEN['hand'] is unchanged (still forbids final_decision) and ROLE_ROLE_HINT['decider'] == 'decider'; the existing role tests pass
tasks.instruction: Touch only lobes/roles.py and its tests. Contract pinned for parallel tasks: role name 'decider', catalog role_hint 'decider', env prefix 'DECIDER', backend name 'decider', task family 'decide', path '/v1/systemone'. Mirror how 'associate' was added (git log -S associate -- lobes/roles.py).

tasks.summary: Add catalog entries for the two decision checkpoints, with a new decide task and a sidecar engine value
acceptance_criteria: lobes/catalog.py has an entry for the chosen 4-bit Clef build (role_hint='decider', task='decide', quantization recorded, hf_revision pinned, status='configured') and one for StrandsAgents/strands-decider-2B-qwen3.5-v1-2610 (role_hint='candidate' or 'decider', quantization='none', bf16, status='configured'); tests/test_catalog.py::test_catalog_ids_are_unique passes
neither entry is selectable by 'lobes switch' as a generate gear (serves_with_vllm is False for them) — a test asserts it
tasks.instruction: Touch only lobes/catalog.py and tests/test_catalog*.py. Add a task value 'decide' and an engine constant for the decider sidecar (e.g. ENGINE_DECIDER_SIDECAR = 'decider-sidecar'). Pin hf_revision by resolving HEAD via the HF API on the day. Comments carry provenance (card URL) and say PUBLISHED-ELSEWHERE, not measured (#108). If t1 picked a different Clef build, use that one.

tasks.summary: Ship the decider sidecar: a container that serves one decision checkpoint on POST /v1/systemone plus GET /health
acceptance_criteria: lobes/decider_sidecar/ serves POST /v1/systemone forwarding the request body to the loaded model and returning its native response unchanged (Clef's and strands-decider's own shapes), and GET /health returning 200 only once the model is loaded — unit-tested with a fake model under tests/test_decider_sidecar.py
lobes/templates/fleet/Dockerfile.decider builds the sidecar for both backends selected by an env var (DECIDER_BACKEND=clef|strands); no EXPOSE-to-host or port publishing appears in it
tasks.instruction: Mirror lobes/embed_sidecar/ + Dockerfile.embed-st (stdlib/FastAPI server, uv pip install --system, never pip). The strands backend wraps the strands-decider package's model loader in-process rather than running its unauthenticated 'serve'. Bind 0.0.0.0 inside the container only; the compose file (t8a) decides exposure. Read the strands-decider server source to confirm one-checkpoint-per-process (c39/h17) and record the answer in the module docstring.

tasks.summary: Gateway: route POST /v1/systemone by the X-Lobes-Model header to the decider domain, body byte-for-byte, never shed
acceptance_criteria: a gateway test sends POST /v1/systemone with X-Lobes-Model: decider:<domain> and asserts the backend receives the body byte-identical; a request with no header resolves to decider:general

an undeclared domain returns 404 model_not_found; no decider wired or reachable returns 404 role_infeasible; with swap > 75% and iowait > 50% every decider request is still forwarded (never 429) — tests in tests/test_gateway_decider.py
the route sits behind the existing bearer gate (GATEWAY_API_KEY covers /v1/*)
tasks.instruction: Files: lobes/gateway/server.py, _routing.py, _pressure_policy.py, _config.py (+ tests/test_gateway_decider.py). _config.py also gets decider's OPT_IN_BACKENDS / FEASIBLE_ENV (DECIDER_FEASIBLE) / DECIDER_BASE_URL entries — t8 must not touch _config.py. Domains are declared in DECIDER_DOMAINS (name=url, comma-separated, mirroring HAND_LORA_MODULES parsing in _config.py:626-670); 'general' is the default. Do NOT call rewrite_model on this path — the body never carries a model field.

tasks.summary: Readiness: probe decider lanes on their own health path
acceptance_criteria: a test wires a decider backend that 404s /v1/models but answers GET /health 200 and asserts it is reported ready:true; the same backend down reports ready:false
tasks.instruction: File: lobes/gateway/_readiness.py (+ tests/test_gateway_readiness.py). Reuse probe_backend_ready's health_path override (the innereye precedent, _readiness.py:153-158); decider lanes never probe /v1/models.

tasks.summary: Capabilities advert + mesh: announce decider domains as their own roster key, route by domain, refuse conflicts
acceptance_criteria: GET /capabilities lists decider with a domains map (domain -> checkpoint, quant, ready) and the mesh announcement carries the same domains

a unit test announces decider:general from member A and decider:<x> from member B and asserts member C forwards each by domain (X-Lobes-Mesh-Member on the reply); two members announcing one domain with different fingerprints are refused, never silently picked
tasks.instruction: Files: lobes/gateway/_mesh_wire.py, _mesh_roster.py, _mesh_routing.py and the capabilities serializer in server.py (after t5 lands — same file). Advert goes through lobes.roles.role_payload, never a bare asdict. Forward only via the existing single-hop mesh forwarder; send the peer's served id, not a backend name (known 404 trap).

tasks.summary: Render decider lanes: profiles/shapes tables, compose template services (no host ports), up target
acceptance_criteria: 'decider' is in OPT_IN_CORE_ROLES (lobes/profiles/shapes.py) and the schema/render/shape_render/up ROLE_SERVICE tables; machine-as-brain renders nothing for it and an unwired decider renders DECIDER_FEASIBLE=false
each declared domain renders a decider-<domain> service from lobes/templates/fleet/Dockerfile.decider with no 'ports:' mapping — asserted by a golden/shape test
tasks.instruction: Files: lobes/profiles/{shapes,schema,render,shape_render}.py, lobes/cli/_commands/up.py, lobes/templates/fleet/docker-compose*.yml (or a generated override for per-domain services), env.example. Service list is data (DECIDER_DOMAINS), so per-domain services belong in the generated docker-compose.shape.yml, not a static template. Every up carries --no-deps; give no service a depends_on on decider.

tasks.summary: Orin shape orin-decider (orin-embed + decider:general) and the exclusive heavy-lobe group; regenerate goldens
acceptance_criteria: lobes/profiles/builtin_shapes/orin-decider.toml hosts embedder, reranker, the gemma2-embed lane and decider; orin.toml [[exclusive_roles]] lists it, and tests/test_init_coresidency.py refuses it alongside orin-cortex/orin-lobe/orin-associate
uv run python tests/goldens/regen.py regenerates every golden with the decider line and 'uv run pytest -n auto' passes
tasks.instruction: Copy orin-embed.toml and add decider; budgets stay DECLARED until t11 measures them (#108 wording). Run goldens regen last, after every render change has landed.

tasks.summary: Docs: decider role page, colleague-stack justification, rollback procedure, a lobes route worked example
acceptance_criteria: docs/decider.md covers both checkpoints, the quant answer for each (Clef: weight-only 4-bit on Ampere; Strands 2B: bf16, no quant), the X-Lobes-Model header, the pass-through response formats, the no-shed rule, and the Orin backup-restore rollback (never re-render alone)
docs/colleague-stack.md records why decider earns an irreversible role, and docs/decider.md shows lobes route's gear choice as a concrete /v1/systemone choice question (the named consumer for h2)
CLAUDE.md's role list, docs/openai-api.md and 'lobes explain' mention decider; markdownlint-cli2 passes on every touched doc
tasks.instruction: Every claim not yet measured is marked DECLARED/UNVALIDATED (#108). Do not name experimental/side models seen on any box.

acceptance_criteria: docs/evidence/<date>-accept-orin-decider.txt records the ~/.lobes backup path taken BEFORE 'lobes init --shape orin-decider --apply', and the four lanes (embedder, reranker, gemma2-embed, decider) all answering through the gateway afterwards

the decider port is refused from another host while the gateway route answers; GET /capabilities on another mesh member shows decider:general hosted by the Orin

Gateway built from a TestPyPI dev wheel of this branch. Never name non-fleet containers in the transcript.

tasks.summary: Live second-box acceptance: serve the stock Strands Decider 2B bf16 on spark2 as a decider domain, reached cross-box from every member
acceptance_criteria: docs/evidence/<date>-accept-decider-2b-spark2.txt shows StrandsAgents/strands-decider-2B-qwen3.5-v1-2610 served bf16 on spark2 as decider:<domain> and answered via X-Lobes-Model from the Orin, the Spark and the Thor gateways, each reply carrying X-Lobes-Mesh-Member: spark2
the stock checkpoint is used — no retrained adapter is required for this task (retraining is the jev-factory session's output, c18)
tasks.instruction: spark2's login user is spark2, sudo needs a password, no Tailscale SSH. Pick a neutral domain name for the stock checkpoint (e.g. 'strands-general'); record the choice.

acceptance_criteria: docs/evidence/<date>-ab-clef-vllm-vs-sidecar-orin.txt reports, on the same labeled probe set, median latency, top-1 accuracy and resident memory for both paths; the faster path is adopted only if it does not lose accuracy
the vLLM image used is recorded by digest and its vLLM version (>= 0.31.0) and an aarch64 + sm_87 build is confirmed — or the task records a NO-GO with the failing step
tasks.instruction: Apply the JRamirez card's 4-line qwen3_5 embed-quant patch and its clef_vllm.py pooling wrapper; keep the decision head in bf16. SGLang dev-clef is the fallback if no aarch64/sm_87 vLLM 0.31 exists.

risks.text: An aarch64 + sm_87 vLLM >= 0.31 image may not exist; the faster path (t13) can end as a NO-GO, leaving the transformers sidecar as the served path
If t1 is a NO-GO for every 4-bit build, Clef cannot be served on the Orin at all; the plan stops at t1 and goes back to the user (the 2B path, t12, does not depend on Clef's quant)
Clef + orin-embed may not fit together under the 2 GiB floor; c16 makes co-residency conditional on the measurement — a misfit reopens the shape decision with the user, not a silent gear drop
